compact_calibration.chow_motive_summand: rank-18 direct summand of the rational divisor Tate motive; Q(phi) acts with the Chow projector as its unit
compact_calibration.semialgebraic_section: the positive component of the 4phi eigenspace cut by the eleven transported divisor half-spaces

theorem.correspondence: a multiple of every rational self-adjoint source operator is induced on NS by a transpose-invariant integral sum of divisor products
theorem.exact_hodge_index_gate: for an isometric full-trace-form carrier: one Lorentzian real place, negative-definite conjugate places, and hence a negative-definite NS orthogonal complement
theorem.hodge_necessity_does_not_cover: an arbitrary unrelated surface realization that does not contain the full restriction-of-scalars trace form
theorem.rational_chow_motive_action: the trace-space orthogonal projector is a divisor-product Chow idempotent, and F acts on its Tate-motive image; a chosen field generator becomes integral only after scaling
theorem.scope: every integral Lorentzian lattice, and hence every admissible totally-real arithmetic Coxeter datum after restriction of scalars
